title: Connect AI tools to 9,000 apps with Zapier MCP
byline: — Marcus Rush, Founder & Team Leader at Rush Home
excerpt: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any AI client to 9,000+ apps. Your agent finds the right action and runs it, with auth and permissions managed by Zapier.
content_html:
Go from AI chat to AI action

Zapier MCP lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any other AI client take real action in the apps that run your business — all with managed auth and permissions you control.

Trusted by the world’s best companies

Describe your goal. Let MCP figure out the rest.

Most AI makes you choose every action or tool before it does any work. Zapier MCP works differently. Tell it what you want to do, and your agent searches Zapier’s 9,000+ apps and 66,000+ triggers and actions to find the right tools for the job. When no standard action fits, it writes and runs code to reach an internal API or reshape data on the fly.

How it works

step 1

Connect Zapier MCP

Add it to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or another supported client.

step 2

Choose your apps

Gmail, Slack, Salesforce, and more. The apps you’ve connected to your Zapier account will show up automatically, and you can connect new ones.

step 3

Tell your agent what to do

Your agent discovers the right action, asks for any missing details, and runs your workflow.

What comes next

Save useful workflows as reusable Skills or deploy them as Zaps that runs independently — so your one-off actions become long-term solutions your team can count on.

Builders are already doing real work
with Zapier MCP

More than 150,000 people have already run agent-led actions through Zapier.

500,000+

MCP servers created

25,000,000

Tool calls completed

1,300,000

Apps connected

Whether you’re a team of one or an organization of thousands, Zapier MCP makes your AI useful.

For individuals and teams

Get more productive in minutes

Connect Zapier MCP once, choose the apps it can use, and start asking your AI to act. Save what works as a Skill.

For enterprise

Agent access meets complete control

Zapier gives IT one place to manage which apps agents can access (and which actions they can take), whether you use Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or another tool.

  • Credentials managed by Zapier

  • App and action-level access controls

  • History for every MCP action

  • SOC 2 Type II certified

Use cases

What will you build with Zapier MCP?

Cross-app catch-up

“Check what changed across Slack, Gmail, and my calendar today. Summarize what needs a reply.”

Meeting prep

“Prep me for today’s customer call using Calendar, Gmail, and Salesforce.”

Reach an internal API

“Enrich these contacts from our internal API and update HubSpot.”

Save what works

“Save this meeting-prep workflow as a Skill you can reuse or deploy it as a Next Gen Zap (early access).”

FAQs

Zapier MCP is a secure way to connect AI clients such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor to the apps you use through Zapier. Your agent can discover and run actions while Zapier manages the connections and access controls.

No. Connect Zapier MCP, choose the apps it can use, and ask for the outcome you want. Most people can get started in just a few minutes.

Zapier MCP gives the agent discovery tools instead of loading every action into the conversation. The agent searches for the capability it needs, gathers missing details, and runs the selected action.

Skills are reusable workflows created in chat. Save a process that worked, share it, and use it across supported AI clients.

Code Actions let your agent write and run custom code when no standard Zapier action fits, including work with internal APIs and custom data transformations.

Zapier manages app credentials outside the model and lets you control which apps and actions the agent can use. MCP action History gives you a record of what ran.

They work together. MCP is where work starts: your AI discovers and runs actions across your apps. When that work needs to keep running, you turn it into a Zap with a trigger, an owner, and a record of every run. Building and deploying Next Gen Zaps from supported AI clients is now available in early access.

Zapier MCP is included in every Zapier plan. No new contract. No procurement process. If you're already on Zapier, you already have access. MCP tool calls use tasks from your Zapier plan's quota. MCP tool calls are free through noon Eastern time on Jan. 5, 2027. Learn more about pricing on our rate card.

Yes. Zapier MCP gives developers access to 30,000+ actions across 9,000+ apps via the MCP standard. See our technical documentation for setup examples, API reference, and framework integrations.

Yes. Zapier MCP respects all account-level restrictions: action restrictions, managed connections, app access controls, and workspace scoping. IT can enable or disable MCP per workspace.

Building is free from any surface, including through Zapier MCP. During Early Access, running Next Gen Zaps is free until billing starts on Dec. 1, 2026. See how Next Gen Zap pricing works.

Put your AI to work
